preferences.name: zen-page-skip.next-shortcut
preferences.title: Next page shortcut
preferences.description: Key combination used to go to the next page. Examples: Alt+], Ctrl+Alt+Right, Alt+N.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.previous-shortcut
preferences.title: Previous page shortcut
preferences.description: Key combination used to go to the previous page. Examples: Alt+[, Ctrl+Alt+Left, Alt+P.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.disabled-sites
preferences.title: Disabled sites
preferences.description: Comma- or newline-separated hostnames. Use *.example.com to disable subdomains without disabling example.com itself.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.cooldown-ms
preferences.title: Shortcut cooldown (milliseconds)
preferences.description: Minimum time between shortcut actions. Values from 0 to 5000 are accepted; default is 400.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.toast-enabled
preferences.title: Show feedback toasts
preferences.description: Show or hide pagination feedback messages.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.toast-duration-ms
preferences.title: Toast duration (milliseconds)
preferences.description: How long feedback toasts remain visible. Values are clamped to 500–10000 milliseconds.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.confidence-threshold
preferences.title: Pagination confidence threshold
preferences.description: Minimum candidate score from 50 to 150. Higher values reduce false positives; default is 70.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.excluded-selectors
preferences.title: Excluded control selectors
preferences.description: Optional newline-separated CSS selectors. Matching controls and their descendants are ignored.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.debug-mode
preferences.title: Enable local diagnostics
preferences.description: Log pagination candidates and navigation decisions locally. No data is sent anywhere.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.next-words
preferences.title: Additional next-page labels
preferences.description: Comma- or newline-separated exact labels for next-page controls. Matching is case-insensitive.

preferences.name: zen-page-skip.previous-words
preferences.title: Additional previous-page labels
preferences.description: Comma- or newline-separated exact labels for previous-page controls. Matching is case-insensitive.
